title: OTHRYS OS Trust Canal Mission promotion request
goal: Allow an operator to request promotion of an admitted DECK-MISSION proposal through a second Trust Canal admission without creating a canonical mission or starting execution.
laws: Promotion request requires an existing DECK-MISSION proposal identity.
Promotion request is separately content-bound and admitted as DECK-PROMOTE-*.
Only the separately authenticated tablet control boundary may submit it.
Promotion request never creates missions/*.json by itself.
Promotion request never starts Talos, Hephaestus, Factory, Worker, shell or model execution.
The original proposal remains visible after a promotion request is submitted.
Replay is idempotent and malformed proposal identities fail closed.
